认为一次失败就应当终止重试。
认为领取不改变消息的可见状态。
认为领取使消息进入限时不可见，超时后自动回到可见。
optionMeanings_en: Assumes the message only lives in the worker's memory.
Assumes one failure should end all retries.
Assumes claiming does not change the message's visibility.
Assumes claiming makes the message invisible for a bounded time, then visible again.
optionDirectness: 持久队列的意义正是消息不随消费者一起死。
重试次数阈值存在的原因就是不要一次就放弃。
只有明确设计成竞争消费、且写操作可交换时才成立。
抓住了「不可见期 + 超时回滚」这个中间状态。
optionDirectness_en: The whole point of a durable queue is that messages outlive their consumer.
The retry threshold exists precisely so one failure is not the end.
Only holds in a deliberately competing-consumer design where writes commute.
Captures the intermediate state: an invisibility window that rolls back on timeout.
optionScenarioImpacts: 10 万页里悄悄少了几页，且没有任何信号提示。
偶发的进程被杀会不断制造需要人工介入的死信。
正常情况下也会重复处理，重复率远高于崩溃场景。
崩溃只推迟这条 task 一个超时周期，其余任务不受影响。
optionScenarioImpacts_en: A few pages quietly go missing from the 100k with no signal at all.
Routine process kills generate a constant stream of dead letters needing human hands.
Even the healthy path duplicates work, far more often than crashes would.
A crash only delays that one task by a single timeout window and nothing else.

termDefinitions.meaning: 消息被领取后对其他消费者隐藏的时长，SQS 默认 30 秒；到期未确认就重新可见。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The visibility timeout is how long a claimed message stays hidden from other consumers, thirty seconds by default in SQS, after which it reappears if unacknowledged.

termDefinitions.meaning: 同一条 task 被执行两次，最终结果与执行一次相同。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Idempotent means executing the same task twice leaves the same final result as executing it once.

termDefinitions.meaning: 领取次数超过 maxReceiveCount 的消息被转入的旁路队列。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A dead-letter queue receives messages whose receive count exceeded the configured maximum.

scenario: 下游依赖抖了一下，几千个 worker 同时失败、同时按固定间隔重试，把刚恢复的依赖又打挂了。
scenario_en: A downstream dependency blips, thousands of workers fail together, all retry on the same fixed interval, and knock the recovering dependency over again.
q: 补全带抖动的指数退避重试公式。
q_en: Complete the exponential-backoff-with-jitter retry formula.
text: 退避时长 = min(上限, base × 2^{{尝试次数}})，再叠加{{随机}}抖动打散重试时刻；AWS 推荐的 full jitter 写法是在 0 到该退避值之间{{均匀取一个}}值。没有抖动，恢复瞬间会出现同步重试的尖刺。
text_en: Backoff = min(cap, base × 2^{{attempt}}), then add {{random}} jitter to spread the retry instants; AWS's full-jitter form {{picks uniformly}} between zero and that backoff value. Without jitter, recovery brings a synchronized retry spike.
why: 指数退避控制的是「重试多密」，jitter 控制的是「大家会不会同时重试」——两件事都要，只做指数退避仍会形成同步洪峰。
why_en: Exponential backoff controls how often you retry while jitter controls whether everyone retries at the same instant, and doing only the first still produces a synchronized flood.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每次失败后把等待时长按倍数放大，减轻对故障依赖的压力。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Exponential backoff multiplies the wait time after each failure to reduce pressure on a failing dependency.

termDefinitions.meaning: AWS 推荐的抖动写法：在 0 到当前退避上限之间均匀随机取一个等待时长。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Full jitter is the AWS-recommended form that picks the wait uniformly at random between zero and the current backoff bound.

scenario: 10 万页里有一份加密的坏 PDF，每个领到它的 worker 都会解析失败并崩掉。已配了指数退避重试。
scenario_en: Among the 100k pages sits one corrupt encrypted PDF that crashes every worker that parses it. Exponential backoff retries are already configured.
q: 该怎么处理这条毒消息？
q_en: How do you handle this poison message?
options: 设置最大领取次数，超过阈值把它移入死信队列并告警，主队列继续跑其余任务
把重试次数设为无限，相信坏文件迟早能解析成功，避免误判丢掉真实数据
在 worker 里捕获所有异常并直接确认这条消息，让它悄悄消失不再影响流水线
把这条消息的可见性超时调到几小时，让它长时间不可见，等人有空了再来看它
options_en: Set a max receive count, move it to the dead-letter queue past the threshold with an alert, and let the main queue keep running.
Set retries to unlimited and trust the bad file will eventually parse, so no real data is discarded by mistake.
Catch every exception in the worker and acknowledge the message so it quietly disappears from the pipeline.
Raise this message's visibility timeout to several hours so it stays hidden until somebody has time for it.
tradeoff: 死信队列 vs 静默丢弃：死信保留了证据和告警，代价是要有人真的去看那个队列，否则它只是个更慢的垃圾桶。
why: 毒消息的问题不是失败，而是它会无限循环消耗重试预算和 worker。设阈值把它移出主流程，既止住循环又留下可排查的原件。
why_en: The problem with a poison message is not that it fails but that it loops forever eating retry budget, so a receive-count threshold moves it out while keeping the evidence.
whenOtherWins: 如果失败是明确的瞬时原因（依赖限流、网络抖动），提高重试上限比早早进死信更好——那类失败真的会自己好。
optionMeanings: 用领取次数阈值把反复失败的消息隔离出去。
无限重试，永不放弃这条消息。
吞掉异常，让失败在流水线里不留痕迹。
用超长隐身时间把问题推迟。
optionMeanings_en: Use a receive-count threshold to isolate repeatedly failing messages.
Retry forever and never give up on the message.
Swallow the exception so the failure leaves no trace in the pipeline.
Postpone the problem with a very long invisibility window.
optionDirectness: 抓住了「失败是永久性的」这条性质，止住无限循环。
失败原因确属瞬时（限流、抖动）时才划算。
只有这类失败本就无需追查时才可接受。
只有等待某个已知的外部条件恢复时才合理。
optionDirectness_en: Captures that the failure is permanent and stops the infinite loop.
Only pays off when the failure really is transient, like throttling or a network blip.
Acceptable only when such failures genuinely need no follow-up.
Reasonable only while waiting on a known external condition to recover.
optionScenarioImpacts: 坏 PDF 单独躺在旁路队列里等人看，其余 9.9 万页照跑。
这条消息会一直循环占用 worker，直到有人手工干预。
语料里静默少了一页，检索结果不全却查不出原因。
问题只是被推后几小时，之后依然会周期性崩 worker。
optionScenarioImpacts_en: The bad PDF sits alone in a side queue for review while the other 99,999 pages proceed.
That one message keeps cycling through workers until a human intervenes.
One page silently vanishes from the corpus and retrieval gaps have no traceable cause.
The problem is merely deferred a few hours and then crashes workers again.

termDefinitions.meaning: 领取次数超过上限的消息被自动转入的旁路队列，供排查与手工重投。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A dead-letter queue automatically receives messages that exceeded the maximum receive count, for inspection and manual replay.

termDefinitions.meaning: 内容本身有问题、导致每个消费者都失败的消息。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A poison message is one whose content makes every consumer fail on it.

termDefinitions.meaning: 消息被领取后对其他消费者隐藏的时长。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The visibility timeout is how long a claimed message stays hidden from other consumers.

scenario: bulk-move 的 task 被可见性超时重投，同一封邮件的移动会执行两次；job 的 processed 计数也可能被加两次。
scenario_en: A bulk-move task is redelivered after a visibility timeout, so the same message is moved twice and the job's processed counter may be incremented twice.
q: 怎么让重复执行不破坏进度计数？
q_en: How do you keep duplicate execution from corrupting the progress count?
options: 把计数改成每次读 task 表现算一遍 count(*)，不再维护 processed 这个累加字段
给每条 task 一个状态，在同一个事务里做「状态从 pending 改成 done」并只在这次改动成功时才自增计数
在 worker 里加一个内存里的已处理 id 集合，处理前先查一下，重复的直接跳过不再执行
把 processed 的自增改成分布式锁保护的临界区，同一时刻只允许一个 worker 修改这个计数，其余的排队等锁
options_en: Drop the processed field and recompute count(*) from the task table on every read.
Give each task a status and, in one transaction, move it from pending to done and increment the counter only if that transition succeeded.
Keep an in-memory set of processed ids in the worker and skip anything already seen.
Protect the processed increment with a distributed lock so only one worker mutates the counter at a time while the rest queue for it.
tradeoff: 状态转移守卫计数 vs 每次现算：状态守卫让计数 O(1) 且永远可信，代价是每条 task 多一次条件更新；现算永远准确但读越多越贵。
why: 幂等的关键是「只在状态真的发生转移时才计数」——第二次执行看到 task 已是 done，条件更新影响 0 行，计数就不会再加。
why_en: Idempotency comes from counting only when the status actually transitions, so a second execution finds the task already done, updates zero rows, and never double-counts.
whenOtherWins: 如果 task 表本来就很小、读频率也低，直接按状态现算 count 反而更简单，省掉一个可能对不上的冗余字段。
optionMeanings: 取消冗余计数，每次从明细重新聚合。
用条件状态转移当作计数的守卫。
用进程内记忆去重。
用互斥保护计数的并发修改。
optionMeanings_en: Remove the redundant counter and re-aggregate from detail rows each time.
Use a conditional status transition as the guard for counting.
Deduplicate using memory local to the process.
Guard concurrent counter updates with mutual exclusion.
optionDirectness: task 数量小、读不频繁时它最省心。
抓住了「重复的是执行、不该重复的是转移」这条区别。
worker 重启或换机器后这份记忆就没了。
锁解决并发写冲突，解决不了同一条被处理两次。
optionDirectness_en: Simplest when the task table is small and rarely read.
Captures the distinction that execution repeats but the transition must not.
That memory disappears the moment the worker restarts or moves hosts.
A lock fixes concurrent writes, not the same task being processed twice.
optionScenarioImpacts: 几千条 task 每次查进度都全表聚合一遍，进度接口变慢。
重复执行时计数纹丝不动，processed==total 这个判据始终可信。
跨进程的重复完全拦不住，计数照样虚高。
加了锁也照加两次，因为两次都是「合法」的自增。
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Every progress check re-aggregates thousands of rows and the endpoint gets slow.
Duplicate execution leaves the count untouched, so processed==total stays trustworthy.
Cross-process duplicates slip right through and the count still inflates.
Even with the lock it increments twice, because both increments look legitimate.

termDefinitions.meaning: 同一操作执行多次与执行一次结果相同。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Idempotent means performing the same operation many times leaves the same result as performing it once.

termDefinitions.meaning: 带 WHERE 条件的更新，只有当前状态匹配时才生效，并返回影响行数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A conditional update only applies when the current state matches its WHERE clause and reports how many rows it changed.

scenario: Anytime AI 的面试官明说了他这轮的评分维度。以后每道系统设计题都先把这四条抛出来，细节等被追问再补。
scenario_en: The Anytime AI interviewer stated his grading dimensions outright. From now on, open every system-design answer with these four and fill in details only when probed.
q: 把面试官明说的系统设计四条评分维度排成正确顺序。
q_en: Order the four grading dimensions the interviewer named for system design.
steps: 高负载下可用：自动扩容、队列高可用、限流与背压
整体架构思路：组件、数据流、主干怎么串
异常处理与稳定性：重试、幂等、死信、降级
常规负载下可用：正常路径能跑通、延迟与一致性达标
why: 顺序本身是论证顺序：先让它跑起来，再让它跑得稳，再让它扛住量，最后让它坏得体面。开场把四条一次抛完，后面就是往里填。
why_en: The order is the argument order — make it work, make it correct at normal load, make it survive scale, then make it fail gracefully — and stating all four upfront turns the rest into filling in blanks.

termDefinitions.meaning: 下游处理不过来时让上游减速的机制。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Backpressure slows producers when consumers cannot keep up.

termDefinitions.meaning: 过载或依赖故障时主动关掉次要功能，保住核心路径。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Graceful degradation turns off secondary features under overload or dependency failure so the core path survives.

scenario: Anytime AI 让我设计对 10 万页法律语料的 RAG 问答。我坦言 RAG 细节不熟，讲得零散——这段叙述要能三分钟画完。
scenario_en: Anytime AI asked me to design RAG question answering over 100k pages of legal documents. I admitted the details were unfamiliar and rambled — this narrative needs to be whiteboardable in three minutes.
q: 把 RAG 的离线与在线两条链排成正确顺序。
q_en: Order the offline and online chains of a RAG pipeline.
steps: 在线：把问题向量化后检索 top-k 候选片段
离线：解析文档，按语义边界切成 chunk
在线：把选中的片段拼进 prompt，生成带引用的回答
离线：对每个 chunk 算 embedding，连同来源元数据写入向量库
在线：用 cross-encoder 之类的重排模型对候选精排，裁到最终几条
why: 离线两步建索引、在线三步答问题；检索是粗筛（快、只看向量相似度），重排是精筛（慢、问题和片段一起过模型），两步分工才兼顾召回与精度。
why_en: Two offline steps build the index and three online steps answer the question, with retrieval as the cheap wide filter and reranking as the expensive precise one.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  subgraph 离线
    D["文档"] --> K["切 chunk"] --> E["算 embedding"] --> V[("向量库 + 元数据")]
  end
  subgraph 在线
    Q["用户问题"] --> R["检索 top-k"] --> RR["重排精筛"] --> G["带引用生成"]
  end
  V --> R

termDefinitions.meaning: 检索增强生成：先从语料里检索相关片段，再让模型基于这些片段作答。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Retrieval-augmented generation first fetches relevant passages from a corpus and then has the model answer grounded in them.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把长文档切成的可检索小片段，通常按段落或语义边界切。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A chunk is a small retrievable slice of a long document, usually cut at paragraph or semantic boundaries.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把问题和候选片段拼在一起过一遍模型打分的重排器，精度高但慢。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A cross-encoder scores a query and a candidate passage jointly in one model pass, which is accurate but slow.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把文本映射成向量，使语义相近的文本在向量空间里也相近。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An embedding maps text to a vector so that semantically similar text lands nearby in vector space.

scenario: 用户问「这 10 万页合同里一共提到几家供应商」。这类题答案分散在几乎所有 chunk 里，top-k 检索天然拿不全。
scenario_en: A user asks how many suppliers appear across 100k pages of contracts. The answer is spread over nearly every chunk, so top-k retrieval structurally cannot cover it.
q: top-k 召回不够时的完整性后门是什么？
q_en: What is the completeness escape hatch when top-k recall is not enough?
options: 把 top-k 从 5 调到 200，用更大的召回窗口尽量把相关片段都捞进来
换一个上下文窗口更大的模型，把全部 10 万页原文一次性塞进 prompt 里让它自己找
改走 map-reduce：对所有 chunk 分别抽取，再把中间结果归并成最终答案
在向量库里换更精确的索引算法，靠提高近邻搜索的召回率来补足覆盖
options_en: Raise top-k from 5 to 200 and hope a wider recall window captures everything relevant.
Switch to a longer-context model and stuff all 100k pages into one prompt so it can find them itself.
Switch to map-reduce: extract from every chunk independently, then reduce the partial results into the final answer.
Swap in a more exact index in the vector store and lift coverage by improving nearest-neighbour recall.
tradeoff: map-reduce vs 加大 top-k：map-reduce 换来「每个 chunk 都被看过」的完整性，代价是调用次数与语料规模成正比、又慢又贵。
why: 聚合类问题的答案不在「最相关的几段」里，而在「全部段落」里——这类问题只能牺牲成本换完整性；顺序敏感时用 refine 逐段累积代替并行归并。
why_en: For aggregation questions the answer lives in every passage rather than the most relevant few, so you trade cost for completeness by visiting all of them.
whenOtherWins: 如果问题本来就是「找出最相关的那一条条款」，加大 top-k 或改进检索才对——那类问题不需要看完全部语料。
optionMeanings: 在同一套检索范式里放大召回窗口。
用超长上下文替代检索这一步。
遍历全部 chunk 分别抽取再归并。
在向量索引层面提升近邻搜索质量。
optionMeanings_en: Widen the recall window within the same retrieval paradigm.
Replace retrieval entirely with a very long context window.
Visit every chunk, extract separately, then merge the partials.
Improve nearest-neighbour quality at the index level.
optionDirectness: 答案确实集中在少数几段时，调大 k 就够了。
语料小到能整体装进上下文时它反而最简单。
抓住了「答案分布在全体而非头部」这条性质。
问题出在检索质量而不是覆盖范围时它才有效。
optionDirectness_en: Enough when the answer really does sit in a handful of passages.
Actually simplest when the corpus is small enough to fit in context.
Captures the property that the answer is spread across all passages, not the head.
Only helps when retrieval quality, not coverage, is the failing part.
optionScenarioImpacts: 200 段仍只是 10 万页的零头，漏掉的供应商依旧漏掉。
10 万页远超任何上下文窗口，成本和延迟也不可接受。
每一页都被看过一次，计数类问题才可能给出可信答案。
近邻更准也改变不了「只看 k 条」这个结构性限制。
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Two hundred passages is still a rounding error against 100k pages and suppliers stay missed.
100k pages exceeds any context window, and the cost and latency are unacceptable.
Every page is visited once, which is the only way a counting question can be answered credibly.
Better neighbours do not change the structural limit of only looking at k passages.

termDefinitions.meaning: 先对每个片段独立处理（map），再把所有中间结果归并成最终答案（reduce）。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Map-reduce processes each chunk independently and then merges all partial results into a final answer.

termDefinitions.meaning: 顺序式变体：带着当前的累积答案读下一个片段并更新它，适合顺序有意义的文档。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Refine is the sequential variant that carries a running answer into the next chunk and updates it, which suits documents where order matters.

termDefinitions.meaning: 检索时只返回相似度最高的 k 个片段。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Top-k means retrieval returns only the k most similar passages.

scenario: API 网关要给每个卖家限流保护昂贵的 LLM 层。卖家平时很闲，但导出报表时会在两秒内连发 30 个请求，这是正常用法。
scenario_en: The gateway must rate-limit each seller to protect the expensive model tier. Sellers are idle most of the time but legitimately fire 30 requests in two seconds when exporting a report.
q: 选哪种限流算法，付出什么代价？
q_en: Which rate-limiting algorithm do you pick, and what does it cost you?
options: 滑动窗口：按加权计数抹平边界，任何时刻都不给突发留余地，吞吐更平滑
漏桶：请求先入队再按固定速率匀速流出，把突发彻底整形成恒定速率
固定窗口计数：每分钟清零一次计数器，实现最简单、内存开销也最小
令牌桶：空闲时攒令牌，允许一次性花掉桶容量，代价是瞬时速率可能超过均值
options_en: Sliding window: a weighted count smooths the boundary and leaves no room to burst at any instant.
Leaky bucket: queue requests and drain at a fixed rate, reshaping any burst into a constant stream.
Fixed window counter: reset the counter every minute — simplest to build and cheapest in memory.
Token bucket: accumulate tokens while idle and let a burst spend the whole bucket, at the cost of instantaneous rate exceeding the average.
tradeoff: 令牌桶 vs 滑动窗口：令牌桶用「攒下的额度可以一次花」换来对合法突发的宽容，代价是瞬时并发会高于平均速率；滑动窗口更公平但会误伤导出这类突发。
why: 这里的约束是「突发是正常用法」：令牌桶让闲置时间转化成突发额度，长期均值仍被限住。要的是保护总容量，不是把每一秒都压平。
why_en: The constraint here is that bursts are legitimate, so a token bucket converts idle time into burst allowance while still capping the long-run average.
optionMeanings: 把相邻窗口按时间比例加权求和判断。
请求排队，按固定速率匀速放行。
在固定时间段内累计计数，到点归零。
按速率补充令牌，请求消耗令牌，桶空则拒。
optionMeanings_en: Blend adjacent windows by elapsed-time weight to decide.
Queue requests and release them at a constant rate.
Count within a fixed period and reset at the boundary.
Refill tokens at a rate, spend one per request, reject when empty.
optionDirectness: 多租户里要严格保证互不影响时它更公平。
下游只能吃恒定速率（比如写外部接口）时它最合适。
只有精度要求很低、能接受边界翻倍时才够用。
抓住了「闲置额度可攒起来供合法突发使用」这一点。
optionDirectness_en: Fairer in multi-tenant settings where tenants must not disturb each other.
Best when downstream can only absorb a constant rate, such as an external API.
Only good enough when precision is low and double-rate at the boundary is tolerable.
Captures the idea that idle allowance accumulates and funds a legitimate burst.
optionScenarioImpacts: 导出报表会被误判成滥用，正常功能被限流打断。
突发请求被排队匀速放行，导出的首个响应明显变慢。
两个窗口交界处能挤进两倍请求，保护形同虚设。
导出报表的 30 连发能通过，持续刷接口的滥用者仍被拦住。
optionScenarioImpacts_en: The export burst is mistaken for abuse and a legitimate feature gets throttled.
The burst is queued and paced, so the export's first response gets noticeably slower.
Twice the quota slips through at the window boundary and the protection is hollow.
The 30-request export passes while a client hammering continuously is still blocked.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按固定速率往桶里放令牌、请求取走一个令牌；桶有容量上限，攒下的令牌可一次花掉形成突发。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A token bucket refills at a fixed rate and each request spends one token, so saved tokens up to the bucket size can be spent at once as a burst.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按当前时刻回看固定时长内的请求数，常用相邻两窗加权近似。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A sliding window counts requests over the trailing period, often approximated by weighting two adjacent windows.

termDefinitions.meaning: 请求先排队再按恒定速率流出，把突发整形成匀速。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A leaky bucket queues requests and drains at a constant rate, reshaping bursts into a steady flow.

scenario: 面试官问：一瞬间来了 1 万个请求，你会全部同时执行吗？系统能同时处理的上限是 2000。我当时有思路但缺术语。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks: ten thousand requests arrive at once — do you run them all? The system can handle 2000 concurrently. I had the idea but not the vocabulary.
q: 剩下的 8000 个请求怎么处理？
q_en: What happens to the remaining 8000 requests?
options: 接纳到容量上限，其余进有界积压，积压满了就返回 429 加 Retry-After 主动丢弃
全部同时放行，靠下游数据库和推理服务自己的超时把处理不完的请求淘汰掉
按先到先服务全部接下，同时立刻触发扩容，用新节点在几分钟内把积压跑完
全部放进一个无界队列慢慢消化，绝不拒绝任何请求，保证每个人最终都会被服务到，只是要多等一会儿
options_en: Admit up to capacity, queue the rest in a bounded backlog, and shed with 429 plus Retry-After once it is full.
Let all of them through and rely on downstream database and inference timeouts to drop what cannot be served.
Accept everything first-come-first-served and trigger autoscaling so new nodes drain the backlog in minutes.
Put everything into an unbounded queue and never reject anyone, so everyone is eventually served after a longer wait.
tradeoff: 有界积压 + 主动丢弃 vs 无界排队：主动丢弃换来延迟可预测、内存有上限，代价是一部分用户当场被拒绝。
why: 无界排队等于把拒绝推迟成超时：用户等了 30 秒还是失败，内存却已经被占满。有界积压 + 429 让失败快、可重试，还给了客户端明确的等待时长。
why_en: An unbounded queue only converts rejection into timeout — the user still fails, just thirty seconds later and after your memory is gone — while a bounded backlog with 429 fails fast and tells the client when to come back.
whenOtherWins: 如果这批请求是可以延迟几分钟的批处理（比如离线导出），把它们全部接进持久队列异步跑，比当场拒绝更合适。
diagram:
flowchart LR
  I["1 万请求"] --> G{"网关限流"}
  G -->|容量内 2000| S["立即处理"]
  G -->|有界积压未满| Q["排队等待"]
  Q --> S
  G -->|积压已满| R["429 + Retry-After"]
optionMeanings: 分成接纳、排队、丢弃三档处理。
不做准入，把过载推给下游依赖。
全部接下，指望扩容来兜底。
用无限排队换取零拒绝。
optionMeanings_en: Split traffic into admit, queue, and shed.
Skip admission control and push overload downstream.
Accept everything and count on autoscaling to catch up.
Buy zero rejections with an unlimited queue.
optionDirectness: 抓住了「容量有限、失败要快且可重试」这条约束。
下游本身有强准入控制时才勉强可行。
扩容能在秒级完成时它才来得及。
任务可以等几分钟的异步批处理场景里它才成立。
optionDirectness_en: Captures the constraint that capacity is finite and failure should be fast and retryable.
Barely viable when downstream already enforces strict admission itself.
Only fast enough if new capacity arrives within seconds.
Only holds for asynchronous batch work that can wait minutes.
optionScenarioImpacts: 2000 个正常完成，其余拿到明确的重试时间而不是干等。
数据库连接被占满，连原本能服务的 2000 个也一起失败。
新节点就绪前积压已经压垮当前实例，扩容来不及。
队列吃光内存，等待的人和正在处理的人一起崩。
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Two thousand finish normally and the rest get a concrete retry time instead of a hang.
Database connections saturate and even the 2000 that could have succeeded fail too.
The backlog crushes the current instances before new nodes are ready.
The queue eats memory and takes down both the waiting and the in-flight requests.

termDefinitions.meaning: 限流专用状态码，表示客户端在给定时间内请求过多。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HTTP 429 Too Many Requests is the status code that tells a client it sent too many requests in a given time.

termDefinitions.meaning: 响应头，值可以是秒数也可以是一个绝对时间点，告诉客户端多久后再来。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The Retry-After response header carries either a number of seconds or an absolute date telling the client when to try again.

termDefinitions.meaning: 过载时明确拒绝一部分请求，保住剩余请求的服务质量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Load shedding explicitly rejects some requests under overload to protect the quality of the rest.

scenario: Amazon 那轮问过期商品记账系统选 RDS 还是 NoSQL。我只答了「一致性」，被追问「这是唯一理由吗」就答不上来了。
scenario_en: An Amazon round asked whether the expired-item bookkeeping system should use a relational database or NoSQL. I gave only "consistency" and froze when asked if that was the only reason.
q: 数据库选型该从哪几个维度论证？
q_en: Which axes should a database choice be argued on?
options: 数据形态与关系：实体之间要不要 join、外键是否是核心访问路径
一致性与可用性的取舍：这条写路径能不能接受读到旧值
查询模式：是按主键点查、还是要即席聚合与范围扫描
规模与吞吐：写入量、单分区热点、以及扩容是加机器还是加规格
团队用哪个数据库更熟：选大家最熟的那个，学习成本最低
options_en: Data shape and relationships: do entities need joins, and are foreign keys a core access path?
The consistency-availability trade-off: can this write path tolerate reading a stale value?
Query patterns: point lookups by primary key, or ad-hoc aggregation and range scans?
Scale and throughput: write volume, single-partition hot spots, and whether you scale out or scale up.
Which database the team already knows best, since that has the lowest learning cost.
why: 被追问「还有别的理由吗」时，这四条里任意一条都能接上；过期商品系统里的实体关系和移库事务一起把答案推向关系型。
why_en: When asked for more reasons, any of these four gives you somewhere to go, and for the expired-item system the entity relationships and the move transaction are what push it relational.
optionMeanings: 关系密集、join 是主路径时偏关系型。
强一致的多行写偏关系型，可用优先偏 NoSQL。
即席聚合偏 SQL，纯键值点查偏 NoSQL。
极高写吞吐与弹性伸缩偏 NoSQL。
熟悉度是落地成本，不是选型的技术论据。
optionMeanings_en: Relationship-heavy workloads where joins are the main path lean relational.
Strongly consistent multi-row writes lean relational; availability-first leans NoSQL.
Ad-hoc aggregation leans SQL; pure key-value point lookups lean NoSQL.
Very high write throughput with elastic growth leans NoSQL.
Familiarity is a delivery cost, not a technical selection argument.
optionDirectness: 答不出这条时，多实体一致性的论据就没有落点。
这是我唯一说出口的一条，只有它撑不满一个回答。
不谈查询模式，索引和二级索引设计就无从展开。
不谈规模，就说不清为什么不是「随便哪个都行」。
把它当主要理由，会显得没有从需求出发。
optionDirectness_en: Without this axis, the multi-entity consistency argument has nowhere to land.
This is the only one I said, and alone it cannot fill an answer.
Skip query patterns and there is no basis for index or secondary-index design.
Skip scale and you cannot explain why the choice is not simply arbitrary.
Leading with it makes the decision look detached from requirements.
optionScenarioImpacts: store 与 item 与 storage 三层关系让 join 成为主查询路径。
移库必须原子完成，这条把天平压向关系型。
按门店聚合过期商品是即席查询，SQL 更顺手。
记账写入量有限，规模在这题里不构成压力。
面试官会追问技术理由，这条挡不住第二次追问。
optionScenarioImpacts_en: The store-item-storage chain makes joins the primary query path.
The move must be atomic, and that tips the balance toward relational.
Aggregating expired items per store is ad-hoc querying, which SQL handles naturally.
Bookkeeping write volume is modest, so scale exerts little pressure here.
The interviewer will ask for a technical reason and this one cannot survive the follow-up.

termDefinitions.meaning: 关系型事务的四项保证：原子性、一致性、隔离性、持久性。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ACID stands for atomicity, consistency, isolation, and durability, the four guarantees of a relational transaction.

termDefinitions.meaning: 事先没有为其设计索引或访问路径的临时查询。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An ad-hoc query is one nobody designed an index or access path for in advance.

scenario: 过期商品系统要把一件商品从门店移到仓储区：改 item 状态、写一条 item_storage 记录，两件事必须同生共死。面试官追问：一致性是选关系型的唯一理由吗？
scenario_en: Moving an expired item from a store to a storage area updates the item's status and inserts an item_storage row, and both must succeed or neither. The interviewer asks: is consistency the only reason to go relational?
q: 除了一致性，还能补哪条最有力的理由？
q_en: Beyond consistency, what is the strongest additional reason you can add?
options: 关系型的单机写入吞吐更高，同样硬件下能承接更多的移库请求
数据形态是三层关系：门店、商品、仓储区之间的 join 就是主查询路径
关系型支持字符串主键，而 NoSQL 只能用数字主键做分区，建模会受限
关系型比 NoSQL 更成熟稳定，生产环境出问题的概率天然更低
options_en: Relational databases have higher single-node write throughput, absorbing more move requests on the same hardware.
The data shape is three related entities — store, item, storage area — and joins across them are the main query path.
Relational databases support string primary keys while NoSQL can only partition on numeric keys, limiting the model.
Relational databases are more mature and stable, so production incidents are inherently less likely.
tradeoff: 关系型 vs NoSQL：关系型换来跨表事务和 join，代价是写扩展要靠分库分表，不像键值存储那样加分区就行。
why: 第二条理由要从数据形态出发：三个实体之间的关系本身就是查询内容（这件商品现在在哪个区），这是 join 而不是键值点查。
why_en: The second reason comes from data shape — the relationship between the three entities is itself what you query, which is a join rather than a key lookup.
whenOtherWins: 如果这套系统的访问永远是「按商品 id 取当前位置」这种单点读写、且写入量极大，NoSQL 的弹性扩展反而更合适。
optionMeanings: 宣称关系型在写吞吐上占优。
从实体关系与 join 这条访问路径出发论证。
宣称主键类型限制了 NoSQL 的建模能力。
把成熟度当作选型的技术依据。
optionMeanings_en: Claim relational wins on write throughput.
Argue from entity relationships and joins as the access path.
Claim primary-key types constrain NoSQL modelling.
Treat maturity as the technical basis for the choice.
optionDirectness: 写吞吐恰恰是键值存储通过分区更容易扩的地方。
抓住了「查询的对象是关系本身」这条形态差异。
键值存储的分区键本来就可以是字符串。
它是运维层面的偏好，换个需求也不会改变结论。
optionDirectness_en: Write throughput is exactly where key-value stores scale more easily through partitioning.
Captures the shape difference: the thing being queried is the relationship itself.
Key-value stores accept string partition keys perfectly well.
This is an operational preference that would not change with different requirements.
optionScenarioImpacts: 被追问单机上限时论据立刻塌，反而暴露认知偏差。
「这件商品现在在哪个区」这类查询自然落在 join 上。
一个可验证的错误说法，比答不上来更伤。
面试官会追问「那具体是哪个技术特性」，还是绕回原点。
optionScenarioImpacts_en: One question about single-node limits collapses the argument and exposes the misconception.
Questions like "which area is this item in now" land naturally on a join.
A checkably false claim damages you more than saying nothing.
The interviewer asks which technical property you mean and you are back where you started.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按关联键把多张表的行拼接起来查询。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A join combines rows from multiple tables on a shared key in one query.

termDefinitions.meaning: 键值存储中决定数据落在哪个分片上的字段，可以是字符串。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The partition key decides which shard a record lands on in a key-value store, and it may be a string.

scenario: 被问「百万级请求怎么扛」时我把要点都点到了，但每一条都是被追问才说的。这套清单要能一气呵成讲完。
scenario_en: Asked how the system handles millions of requests, I hit every point but only when prompted. This checklist needs to come out in one breath.
q: 把高并发读系统的分层清单排成从入口到底层的顺序。
q_en: Order the high-read-system checklist from entry point down to storage.
steps: 缓存层：Redis 扛住热点读，把重复查询挡在数据库之前
负载均衡器：健康检查摘除坏实例，按请求量水平扩缩
异步队列与批处理：过期扫描这类后台重活挪出在线路径
无状态服务集群：任意实例可接任意请求，加机器就加吞吐
带索引的数据库：给过滤和排序字段建索引，避免全表扫
why: 顺序就是请求从外到内穿过的层：每一层的职责是「把多少流量挡在自己这里」，挡不住的才往下传。
why_en: The order is simply the path a request takes inward, and each layer's job is to absorb as much traffic as it can before passing the rest down.
diagram:
flowchart TD U["百万请求"] --> LB["负载均衡
健康检查 + 水平扩缩"] LB --> S["无状态服务集群"] S --> C["Redis 缓存
热点读"] C -->|未命中| D[("带索引的数据库")] S --> Q["异步队列
后台扫描与批处理"] Q --> D

termDefinitions.meaning: 负载均衡定期探测实例存活，失败的实例会被摘出流量池。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A health check is the load balancer's periodic probe that removes failing instances from the traffic pool.

termDefinitions.meaning: 实例不保存跨请求状态，因此可以随意增减。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Stateless means an instance keeps no state between requests, so instances can be added or removed freely.

scenario: 过期商品系统要持续找出已过期的商品。表里有上百万行，业务希望「几分钟内」发现过期，同时在线查询不能被拖慢。
scenario_en: The expired-item system must keep finding items past their date. The table holds millions of rows, detection should happen within minutes, and online queries must not slow down.
q: 这个扫描该怎么设计？
q_en: How should that sweep be designed?
options: 给每件商品起一个定时器，到期时由定时器主动触发一次状态更新和通知
每分钟跑一次全表扫描，逐行比较 expiration_ts 和当前时间，逻辑最直白也不会漏
给 expiration_ts 建索引，后台任务按时间窗范围查询、结果推进异步队列处理
在读接口里顺带判断：用户每次查询商品时现算它是否过期，省掉后台任务
options_en: Start a timer per item so it fires at its expiry and triggers a status update and notification.
Run a full table scan every minute comparing expiration_ts to now — the most straightforward logic and nothing is missed.
Index expiration_ts, have a background job range-query one time window at a time, and push results onto an async queue.
Decide inline on reads: compute expiry whenever a user looks up an item, removing the background job entirely.
tradeoff: 索引 + 时间窗分批 vs 全表扫：索引让每轮只碰将要过期的那一小段，代价是写入时要维护索引、且时间窗大小要调。
why: 全表扫的代价随总行数增长，而真正到期的只有很小一段。按 expiration_ts 索引做范围查询，每轮的工作量只跟这个窗口内的行数有关。
why_en: A full scan costs grow with total rows while only a thin slice actually expires, so an indexed range query makes each pass proportional to the window instead of the table.
whenOtherWins: 如果表只有几万行、且过期判断逻辑复杂到索引用不上，定时全表扫其实更简单，不值得引入队列。
optionMeanings: 为每个实体各起一个到期触发器。
每轮遍历全部行来找出到期的那些。
用索引把每轮的扫描范围压到一个时间窗内。
把过期判断推迟到读取那一刻。
optionMeanings_en: Attach a per-entity timer that fires at its expiry.
Walk every row each pass to find the expired ones.
Use an index to confine each pass to one time window.
Defer the expiry decision to read time.
optionDirectness: 实体数少且到期时刻分散时这种方案才管得住。
行数只有几万、且没有可索引条件时才划算。
抓住了「到期行只占全表极小一段」这条分布特征。
只需要展示状态、不需要触发副作用时它足够。
optionDirectness_en: Manageable only with few entities and widely spread expiry times.
Only worth it with tens of thousands of rows and no indexable predicate.
Captures the distribution fact that expiring rows are a tiny slice of the table.
Sufficient when you only display status and trigger no side effects.
optionScenarioImpacts: 上百万个定时器本身就是一套要高可用的系统，成本失控。
每分钟把上百万行读一遍，在线查询被后台扫描抢走 IO。
每轮只碰即将过期的那几百行，在线查询几乎无感。
从没人查过的商品永远不会被标记过期，通知也发不出去。
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Millions of timers become their own highly available system and the cost explodes.
Millions of rows are read every minute and the sweep steals IO from online queries.
Each pass touches only the few hundred rows about to expire and online reads barely notice.
Items nobody looks at are never marked expired and no notification is ever sent.

termDefinitions.meaning: 不用索引、逐行读完整张表的访问方式，代价随行数线性增长。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A full table scan reads every row without an index, so its cost grows linearly with table size.

termDefinitions.meaning: 沿有序索引取出某个区间内的行，只碰该区间的数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A range query walks an ordered index to fetch rows inside an interval and touches only that interval.

scenario: Anytime AI：用户提问后后端跑 10 秒到几分钟，token 边生成边流给前端。用户刷新页面后必须能从中断处接着看。
scenario_en: Anytime AI: a query kicks off a ten-second to several-minute backend job whose tokens stream to the frontend, and a page refresh must resume where it left off.
q: 把可恢复流式响应的五步排成正确顺序。
q_en: Order the five steps of a resumable streaming response.
steps: 客户端重连时带上已收到的最后一个序号，请求从该序号之后继续
提交问题时创建一条持久 job 并立刻返回 job_id，后台任务与 HTTP 请求解耦
服务端先把序号之后的历史 token 重放完，再接上实时流继续推
客户端连到以 job_id 为键的流式端点，而不是连回原来那个请求
模型每生成一个 token，就带单调递增序号写进服务端存储
why: 关键是把「任务的生命周期」和「连接的生命周期」拆开：浏览器关掉，job 照跑；token 存储才是真相来源，客户端的流只是它的一个视图。
why_en: The trick is decoupling the job's lifetime from the connection's — close the browser and the job keeps running, because the token store is the source of truth and the stream is only a view of it.
diagram:
sequenceDiagram
  participant C as 客户端
  participant A as API
  participant W as worker
  participant S as token 存储
  C->>A: 提交问题
  A-->>C: job_id
  C->>A: GET stream by job_id
  W->>S: 写入 seq=1..n
  S-->>C: 实时推送 token
  Note over C: 刷新页面,连接断开
  W->>S: 继续写入 seq=n+1..
  C->>A: 重连,带 last seq=n
  A->>S: 读取 seq > n
  S-->>C: 先重放再续推

termDefinitions.meaning: 给每个 token 分配的单调递增编号，用来定位续传的起点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A sequence number is the monotonically increasing id assigned to each token so a client can say where to resume.

termDefinitions.meaning: SSE 断线重连时浏览器自动带上的请求头，值是最后收到的事件 id。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Last-Event-ID is the header a browser automatically sends when reconnecting an SSE stream, carrying the id of the last event it received.

termDefinitions.meaning: 后台任务的稳定标识，流式端点按它寻址而不是按原始请求。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The job id is the stable handle for a background task, and the streaming endpoint is addressed by it rather than by the original request.

scenario: 流式回答跑到一半用户刷新了页面。此刻已经生成了 400 个 token，其中前 250 个客户端收到过。
scenario_en: The user refreshes mid-answer. By then 400 tokens have been generated and the client had received the first 250.
q: 谁是这段回答的真相来源，重连时怎么补齐？
q_en: What is the source of truth for this answer, and how does the reconnect catch up?
options: 模型进程的内存是真相来源：重连时让模型从头重新生成一遍，保证前后文完全一致
没有真相来源：刷新即视为取消，提示用户重新提问，避免维护额外的存储与状态
客户端本地缓存是真相来源：重连后把本地已有的 250 个 token 发给服务端做比对，再从差集处续传
服务端的 token 存储是真相来源：客户端报出最后序号 250，服务端重放 251 之后再续推
options_en: The model process's memory is the source of truth: on reconnect, regenerate the whole answer so the context matches exactly.
There is no source of truth: treat a refresh as cancellation and ask the user to re-submit, avoiding extra storage and state.
The client's local cache is the source of truth: on reconnect it uploads its 250 tokens, the server diffs them, and streaming resumes from the difference.
The server-side token store is the source of truth: the client reports last sequence 250 and the server replays from 251 then continues live.
tradeoff: 服务端持久化 token vs 刷新即取消：持久化换来刷新不丢答案，代价是多一份带 TTL 的存储和重放逻辑。
why: 客户端连接会断、模型进程会重启，只有那份带序号的服务端存储既持久又有序。给它设一个 TTL（比如 24 小时）就不会无限增长。
why_en: Connections drop and model processes restart, so only the sequenced server-side store is both durable and ordered, and a TTL keeps it from growing forever.
whenOtherWins: 如果回答只有一两秒就生成完、重来的代价可以忽略，刷新即取消确实更简单，不值得引入 token 存储。
optionMeanings: 把权威状态放在会重启的推理进程里。
干脆不维护中间状态。
把权威状态放在最容易消失的一端。
把带序号的服务端存储当作权威记录。
optionMeanings_en: Put authoritative state inside a process that restarts.
Keep no intermediate state at all.
Put the authoritative state on the side most likely to disappear.
Treat the sequenced server-side store as the authoritative record.
optionDirectness: 推理进程本来就可能被回收，谈不上持久。
生成只要一两秒时重来的成本确实可以忽略。
只有同一个客户端永不换设备、也不清缓存时才成立。
抓住了「有序 + 持久」这两条真相来源必须满足的条件。
optionDirectness_en: The inference process can be reclaimed at any time, so it is not durable at all.
Regenerating really is negligible when the answer takes a second or two.
Only holds if the same client never switches device and never clears its cache.
Captures the two properties a source of truth needs here: ordered and durable.
optionScenarioImpacts: 重新生成不仅慢，采样随机性还会让答案和刚才不一样。
跑了几分钟的长任务被一次误刷新彻底作废。
换台设备打开就什么都没有，跨设备场景直接失效。
刷新后前 250 个立刻重放、后 150 个接着推，用户几乎无感。
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Regenerating is slow and sampling randomness makes the answer differ from what was shown.
A multi-minute job is thrown away by one accidental refresh.
Open it on another device and nothing is there, so cross-device breaks entirely.
After the refresh the first 250 replay instantly and the next 150 stream on, nearly invisible to the user.

termDefinitions.meaning: 真相来源：出现分歧时以它为准的那份权威数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The source of truth is the authoritative copy of data that wins whenever versions disagree.

termDefinitions.meaning: 存活时间，到期后数据自动清除。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Time to live is how long data survives before it is deleted automatically.

scenario: Meta 的商家 onboarding 是多步骤流程（政策、目录、联系人、复核）。商家中途离开，几天后换台设备回来要接着填。这道追问我当场答不上来。
scenario_en: Meta's merchant onboarding is a multi-step flow (policy, catalog, contact, review). A merchant leaves midway and returns days later on another device to continue. I could not answer this follow-up live.
q: 「当前在第几步」这个状态该怎么存？
q_en: How should "which step am I on" be stored?
options: 在实体上放一个显式的 current_step 枚举字段存在后端，加载时读它渲染对应步骤
存在 URL 路径里（/onboarding/step-3），靠浏览器历史天然保存进度并支持前进后退
存在浏览器 localStorage 里，读得快、不占后端请求，刷新页面也不会丢
不显式存，靠后端看哪些字段已填、哪些还是空，反推用户应该停在哪一步
options_en: Put an explicit current_step enum on the entity in the backend and read it on load to render the right step.
Keep it in the URL path (/onboarding/step-3) so browser history preserves progress and back-forward work.
Keep it in browser localStorage: fast to read, no backend call, and it survives a refresh.
Do not store it explicitly; have the backend infer the step from which fields are already filled.
tradeoff: 显式后端字段 vs 从数据反推：显式字段换来跨设备可恢复且规则可读，代价是每次推进都要一次写请求。
why: 跨设备是硬约束：状态必须在服务端。反推法看似省一个字段，但「填了一半又回退」这类情况会推出错误的步骤，规则还会随表单变化而腐化。
why_en: Cross-device recovery is the hard constraint, so the state must live server-side, and inferring the step from filled fields breaks the moment a user goes back and edits.
whenOtherWins: 如果流程是纯前端的、一次性完成且不跨设备（比如一个匿名问卷），放 localStorage 或 URL 里确实更轻。
optionMeanings: 把进度作为实体上的一等字段持久化。
把进度编码进地址栏。
把进度放在这台浏览器的本地存储里。
不存进度，用已填字段推断它。
optionMeanings_en: Persist progress as a first-class field on the entity.
Encode progress into the address bar.
Keep progress in this browser's local storage.
Store no progress and infer it from filled fields.
optionDirectness: 抓住了「换设备也要接着填」这条跨端约束。
配合后端字段做深链接时它是好补充。
匿名、单设备、无需服务端记住的流程里够用。
字段与步骤严格一一对应且不可回退时才成立。
optionDirectness_en: Captures the cross-device constraint that another machine must resume the flow.
A good complement for deep links when paired with a backend field.
Enough for anonymous single-device flows the server need not remember.
Only holds when fields map one-to-one to steps and users cannot go back.
optionScenarioImpacts: 任何设备加载时读到同一个步骤，恢复行为完全一致。
用户直接改地址栏就能跳到复核步，绕过前面的校验。
换台设备回来进度归零，商家要从第一步重填。
商家回头改了第二步，系统会把他判定成停在第二步。
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Any device loading the flow reads the same step and resumes identically.
A user can edit the address bar straight to review and bypass earlier validation.
On another device progress resets and the merchant starts from step one.
A merchant who edits step two is judged to be sitting on step two again.

termDefinitions.meaning: 浏览器里按域名隔离的本地键值存储，换设备或清缓存就没了。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: localStorage is a per-origin key-value store inside one browser that disappears if the user switches device or clears data.

termDefinitions.meaning: 取值限定在一组固定常量里的字段，这里对应各个步骤。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An enum field takes values from a fixed set of constants, here one per step of the flow.

scenario: 被问「TikTok 投放配置表单的 source of truth 放前端还是后端」。我答了「后端」但没给理由，也没提混合方案。这是会花钱的配置数据。
scenario_en: Asked whether the TikTok campaign configuration form's source of truth lives client-side or server-side, I said "server" with no reasoning and never mentioned the hybrid. This config spends real money.
q: 配置表单的 source of truth 该怎么定？
q_en: Where should the source of truth for that configuration form live?
options: 各存一份互不覆盖：前端保留用户版本，服务端保留已提交版本，冲突时提示用户手动选
本地乐观更新负责手感，服务端作为权威；冲突时服务端赢，刷新后从服务端重新拉
全放前端内存与 localStorage：读写零延迟，提交时一次性把整份配置发给服务端
全放服务端且不做本地乐观更新：每次改动都等服务端返回后再更新界面
options_en: Keep both copies without overwriting: the client holds the user's version, the server the submitted one, and conflicts prompt a manual choice.
Optimistic local state for responsiveness with the server authoritative; on conflict the server wins and a refresh re-fetches from it.
Everything in frontend memory and localStorage: zero-latency reads and writes, with one final submit to the server.
Everything server-side with no optimistic updates: every edit waits for the server round trip before the UI changes.
tradeoff: 混合方案 vs 纯服务端：混合换来即时手感，代价是要处理乐观更新失败后的回滚与提示。
why: 关键是先点名要防的风险：这是会真花钱的投放配置，配错要付出预算代价，所以权威必须在服务端；本地乐观状态只负责手感，不负责正确性。
why_en: Name the risk first — this configuration spends real budget, so authority has to sit on the server while local optimistic state only buys responsiveness.
optionMeanings: 两份副本并存，冲突交给用户裁决。
本地先行更新界面，服务端持有权威副本。
把权威副本放在这台浏览器里。
所有状态变更都以服务端返回为准再渲染。
optionMeanings_en: Keep both copies alive and let the user resolve conflicts.
The UI updates locally first while the server holds the authoritative copy.
Keep the authoritative copy inside this one browser.
Render only after the server confirms every change.
optionDirectness: 多人协作编辑同一份文档时它才有意义。
抓住了「钱要正确、手感要快」这两条同时成立的要求。
草稿类、丢了也无所谓的数据才配得上这个方案。
每次改动都必须被审计留痕时它更严谨。
optionDirectness_en: Meaningful only when several people edit the same document together.
Captures both requirements at once: money must be correct and the UI must feel fast.
Only suits draft-grade data where losing it costs nothing.
Stricter when every single edit must leave an audit trail.
optionScenarioImpacts: 单用户表单里并不存在真正的并发冲突，白增复杂度。
界面立刻响应，服务端拒绝时回滚并提示，预算不会被写错。
浏览器崩溃就丢掉整份配置，跨设备也看不到草稿。
每调一个滑块都要等一个往返，配置体验明显发涩。
optionScenarioImpacts_en: A single-user form has no real concurrent conflict, so this only adds complexity.
The UI responds instantly, a server rejection rolls back with a message, and budgets are never written wrong.
A browser crash loses the whole configuration and no other device sees the draft.
Every slider drag waits for a round trip and the configuration flow feels sluggish.

termDefinitions.meaning: 真相来源：多份副本不一致时以它为准的那一份。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The source of truth is the copy that wins whenever multiple copies disagree.

termDefinitions.meaning: 先按预期结果更新界面，等服务端确认；失败则回滚。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An optimistic update renders the expected result immediately and rolls back if the server rejects it.

termDefinitions.meaning: 浏览器本地键值存储，按域名隔离，换设备不共享。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: localStorage is a per-origin key-value store in one browser that is not shared across devices.
